name: Inspiring Leader
body:
Your presence in combat bolsters the morale of your soldiers.

Prerequisite(s): Leadership.

Benefit: Your followers and cohort gained through Leadership gain a +1 morale bonus to attack and damage rolls and a +2 morale bonus on Will saves. This functions as long as they are within 100 feet of you and can see and hear you.
